properties.rule: optimizer.hpp Optimizer::Run: 'Returns false if |original_binary| fails to validate or if errors occur when processing |original_binary| using any of the registered passes. In that case, no further passes are executed'. opt/pass_manager.cpp:77 resets every pass that ran to nullptr and clears the pass list only after a fully successful run, so after a run that failed in a pass the optimizer holds null passes, and the next run (pass_manager.cpp:58) or Optimizer::GetPassNames dereferences them (repro2.cpp case 3). A failed run cannot be told apart from a failed validation, so after any failed run the optimizer is destroyed before it is run again. Applies to the C optimizer (spvOptimizerRun) and to the C++ one.
